body.name: \(\mathfrak H^{\mathrm{low}}\)
body.construction: Freeze \(p_x\), \(f_x=f^{\circ}\), and two fixed nonidentical asymmetric error densities formed as distinct mixtures of shifted and scaled \(\operatorname{sinc}^4\) densities.  Put a compactly supported weighted Jacobi reproducing-kernel, moment-annihilating packet into a Bernoulli conditional mark, while leaving the latent density and both error laws fixed.  Choose its amplitude to preserve strict \(H^\beta\) slack and the Bernoulli range, use its factorial attenuation in the observed signed marked channel, and finish with the honest-band testing reduction.
